children: Daktronics announced that Bradley T. Wiemann retired as Executive Vice President — Advisor to the CEO, effective September 5, 2026.
Executive Vice President — Advisor to the CEO; formerly served in leadership roles including Interim President and Interim Chief Executive Officer
Retirement pursuant to the Amended and Restated Termination Agreement and General Release of Claims
Served the company for more than 34 years in various leadership roles, including Interim President and Interim Chief Executive Officer
